research.title: Visual Baselines for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Prepared labeled surface images by checking annotation consistency, removing duplicate crops, and preserving source groups across training and evaluation splits.
Implemented a prescribed classifier using local texture descriptors and a support vector machine, then inspected confusion patterns across defect categories.

research.title: Object Classification Under Illumination Variation
bullets: Organized object images by category and lighting condition, checked unreadable files, and applied consistent resizing for baseline experiments.
Implemented color histogram features with a nearest neighbor classifier and compared classification errors across lighting conditions using the supplied evaluation split.

work.title: Image Upload Validation and Preprocessing
bullets: Implemented image upload checks for unsupported formats, invalid dimensions, and corrupted files within an existing processing workflow.
Added regression tests for resizing and file validation behavior, reproduced reported failures, and documented handling of problematic uploads.

projects.title: Color Histogram Baseline for Image Retrieval
bullets: Implemented an image retrieval baseline using normalized color histograms and distance based ranking over a supplied collection.
Evaluated retrieval precision using category labels and examined mismatches associated with similar backgrounds and differing object colors.

projects.title: Color Clustering Baseline for Foreground Segmentation
bullets: Implemented a foreground segmentation baseline using color clustering, with a supplied border heuristic to identify likely background regions.
Compared predicted masks with provided annotations using intersection over union and inspected failures involving shadows and similar foreground and background colors.
